title: Discovery of 3,5-dimethylisoxazole derivatives as novel, potent inhibitors for bromodomain and extraterminal domain (BET) family.
authors: Fang, Lincheng; Hu, Zhaoxue; Yang, Yifei; Chen, Pan; Zhou, Jinpei; Zhang, Huibin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BET溴结构域小分子抑制剂的设计与抗肿瘤活性，属于蛋白-小分子药物研发，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Bromodomain and extra-terminal (BET) is a promising therapeutic target for various hematologic cancers. We used the BRD4 inhibitor compound 13 as a lead compound to develop a variety of compounds, and we introduced diverse groups into the position of the compound 13 orienting toward the ZA channel. A series of compounds (14-23, 38-41, 43, 47-49) bearing triazolopyridazine motif exhibited remarkable BRD4 protein inhibitory activities. Among them, compound 39 inhibited BRD4(BD1) protein with an IC(50) of 0.003 muM was superior to lead compound 13. Meanwhile, compound 39 possess activity, IC(50) = 2.1 muM, in antiproliferation activity against U266 cancer cells. On the other hand, compound 39 could arrest tumor cells into the G0/G1 phase and induce apoptosis, which was consistent with its results in inhibiting cell proliferation. Biological and biochemical data suggest that BRD4 protein might be a therapeutic target and that compound 39 is an excellent lead compound for further development.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域和末端外结构域（BET）是多种血液系统癌症的有前景的治疗靶点。我们以BRD4抑制剂化合物13为先导化合物，开发了一系列化合物，并在化合物13朝向ZA通道的位置引入了多种基团。带有三唑并吡嗪母核的一系列化合物（14-23、38-41、43、47-49）表现出显著的BRD4蛋白抑制活性。其中，化合物39对BRD4(BD1)蛋白的抑制活性IC(50)为0.003μM，优于先导化合物13。同时，化合物39对U266癌细胞具有抗增殖活性，IC(50) = 2.1μM。另一方面，化合物39能将肿瘤细胞阻滞在G0/G1期并诱导凋亡，这与其抑制细胞增殖的结果一致。生物学和生物化学数据表明，BRD4蛋白可能是一个治疗靶点，而化合物39是进一步开发的优秀先导化合物。
